sources.title: Ulf Mark Schneider biography preview
sources.findings: Born 9 September 1965 in Neuwied; education 1988 St Gallen, doctorate 1992, Harvard MBA 1993.
sources.caution: Only public preview read, not subscriber continuation; do not confuse namesakes in jewelry, religious podcasts or Schneider Electric.

sources.title: June 2016 curriculum vitae
sources.findings: Fresenius Medical Care CFO from November 2001; Fresenius Group CEO from May 2003; Haniel since 1989; US citizenship 2003.
sources.caution: One-page historical CV, not current mandates; Fresenius Medical Care distinct from Fresenius Group.

sources.title: Dr Mark Schneider biography
sources.findings: Roche board since 2023; Siemens supervisory board since 2025; German/US nationality; earned Lic oec 1988, doctorate 1992 and MBA 1993.
sources.caution: Board membership is not Roche CEO role; no medical qualification inferred from doctoral title.

sources.title: 27 June 2016 management announcement
sources.findings: CEO appointment effective 1 January 2017; joining 1 September 2016 for introductory period; board election proposed for 2017 AGM.
sources.caution: Joining date, CEO start and board election are different; announcement cross-checked later official biographies.

sources.title: 23 August 2024 prospectus supplement
sources.findings: Page 6: resignation from CEO and board effective 1 September 2024, Freixe succeeds as CEO.
sources.caution: Read targeted management paragraph, not incorporated financial reports; August22 announcement is not effective departure. Freixe subsequent conduct not attributed to Schneider.

sources.title: Current Supervisory Board roster
sources.findings: Schneider member since 13 February 2025; Roche non-executive director; Snabe current chair.
sources.caution: Not Siemens CEO or current chair; neighboring March2026 appointment belongs to another member.

sources.title: 13 February 2025 AGM results
sources.findings: Shareholders elected Schneider to supervisory board for four years, described as potential chair successor.
sources.caution: Future four-year term not already served; supervisory board and managing board distinct.

sources.title: 10 March 2026 AGM minutes, English translation
sources.findings: Opening explicitly records Schneider attendance; item6.9 records reelection for one year.
sources.caution: Read opening and item6.9, not all31pages. English item6.9 says until AGM2026 despite one-year election at AGM2026; record inconsistency, do not adopt end-year. German original not read.

sources.title: 2026 AGM release
sources.findings: Lists Schneider among reelected directors for one year.
sources.caution: Confirms completed election rather than nomination; no video review.

sources.title: 12 May 2026 succession plan
sources.findings: Official reproduced release states intention to elect Schneider chair after 11 February 2027 AGM.
sources.caution: Read dated opening/body, not linked original PDF; future intended election is not completed chair appointment. Current Siemens roster still names Snabe.
